observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive gearbox (transmission) in a pile of other engine parts.
The unit has a 22-pin input/output connector visible on the side.
The casing shows significant surface rust and dirt, consistent with a used or scrap part.
The internal components are not visible; only the exterior casing and the connector are shown.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or seized gears
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being manually rotated or a photo of the internal splined shaft.

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment (wrong Toyota model or year)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number stamped on the casing.
A photo of the connector assembly and the pins.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number stamped on the gearbox casing.
Photo of the 22-pin connector to confirm pin count and condition.
Video showing the gearbox being turned by hand to check for smooth operation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
